D04-15:00.topic: Sharpe Ratio: Return per Unit of Risk
D04-15:00.script_full: Are you taking too much risk for tiny returns in your portfolio? Most investors ignore the hidden danger of market volatility completely. Finally, CRR forces Indian banks to keep a mandatory percentage of total deposits liquid with the RBI as ultimate safety. When repo rates rise, your EMIs increase and markets usually correct.
